name: Linagliptin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 5 mg once daily, with or without food

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong P-gp or CYP3A4 inducers (e.g., rifampin)

key_interactions.action: Lower insulin or secretagogue doses may be needed.

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to linagliptin or any excipient
monitoring: Signs of heart failure in at-risk patients

pk.half_life: Terminal over 100 hours (about 200 hours at steady state; saturable DPP-4 binding); accumulation half-life about 11 to 12 hours
pk.half_life_eskd: No prolongation of accumulation or terminal half-life in moderate impairment (label)
pk.protein_binding: Concentration dependent: about 99% at low to 75% to 89% at higher levels
pk.metabolism: Minor; about 90% excreted unchanged; one inactive metabolite
pk.dialyzability: Unlikely by hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis (label).

sources.citation: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals, Inc.. (2025). Tradjenta (linagliptin) [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA201280, set ID c797ea5c-cab7-494b-9044-27eba0cfe40f, version effective March 21, 2025]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
